data.one_liner: A task runner for Dart to define and automate project workflows.
data.what_it_does: Grinder helps developers define project tasks like building, testing, and deploying entirely in Dart code. It provides a command-line tool to run these tasks with support for dependencies, default tasks, and command-line arguments.
use_when: You want to write build and automation scripts in Dart instead of shell scripts or Makefiles.
Your project requires ordered task dependencies like running tests only after a successful build.
avoid_when: You prefer external build tools or standard shell scripts for workflow automation.
strengths: Allows leveraging the full Dart ecosystem to write and debug task definitions.
Supports task dependencies and passing command-line flags and options.
weaknesses: Requires maintaining task scripts inside a `tool/grind.dart` file.
data.setup_notes: Add grinder to dev_dependencies and run `dart run grinder:init` to create a grinder script.
